slimeContact.status: balloon correction and original wind slime contact accepted; float and diver contact unresolved

The original wind-tunnel slime now uses its actual adaptive quadratic curve and a frictionless moving-wall normal constraint. Enlarged phone views show water meeting its wet upper flank and crest. Float underside and diver flank gaps still reject universal contact.

It does not establish wet underside contact or contact for additional slimes. Ordinary buoyancy and flow coupling remains one-way; system momentum and energy closure is not claimed.
